services.name: 4th of July Sunset Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: Come join for Fort Lauderdale 4th of July Spectacular Fest!! Tour will begin at 7.30pm for a sunset cruise around Fort Lauderdale. Coolers with ice and water will be provided and please bring anything else you would like. Fireworks start at 8:45 and will last approx 45 min. On our way back you will take in the spectacular night views of our city consisting of large yachts, mansions and 4th of July Sunset Firework Special!

services.name: Christmas Lights Show Boat Tours
services.desc: We invite you to explore Fort Lauderdale’s holiday spirit aboard our spacious, comfy pontoon boats. Our city is designed for boating bliss, and during the holiday season, our many waterways become a Christmas lights show like no other. Our large pontoon boats comfortably seat up to 12 passengers, with multiple seating areas to comfortably cruise. Our boat tours are private and fully customizable. So please start a new holiday tradition with our Christmas Lights Boat All Ages · 2.5 Hours
